stories.title: Council tax rises a matter for councils, says First Minister
stories.summary: Decisions on council tax rises should stay with local councils, the First Minister has said, as Flintshire County Council faces a budget gap of up to £22 million next year. stories.title: Fine for leaving engine running while parked rises to up to £150 in Wales
stories.summary: Drivers in Wales who leave their engines running while parked face fines of up to £150 from today, up from £20. stories.title: Airbus A350F freighter with Broughton-built wings makes first flight
stories.summary: A new Airbus cargo plane with wings built at Broughton has made its first flight. The first A350F freighter test aircraft took off from Toulouse on Tuesday 29 September and flew for four hours and 10 minutes, reaching 25,000 feet and a speed of 340 knots. stories.title: Cafe plan for empty Grade II listed shop on Holywell High Street
stories.summary: An empty shop in a Grade II listed building on Holywell High Street, once home to the Spread Eagle pub, could become a cafe under plans submitted to Flintshire Council. stories.title: Restaurant, flats and smaller Post Office planned for The Highway in Ewloe
stories.summary: Ewloe Post Office would be reduced in size to make room for a restaurant, with three flats created in the rest of the building, under plans submitted to Flintshire Council.
